name: mac-dir-stat
one_liner: Treemap directory-size visualizer for macOS — find what's eating your disk and reclaim it

kill_criteria.statement: Two consecutive quarters with flat/declining GitHub stars AND no growth in weekly scan-completers (telemetry) → revert to maintain

north_star: GitHub stars — adoption proxy; ≥75 unlocks homebrew/cask notability. Guard metric: weekly scan-completers from telemetry.

decisions.rationale: Revive maintain→growing: v0.5.1 signed+notarized shipped, WinDirStat parity gains, analytics live, active star-growth push toward homebrew/cask notability.

notes: Adoption (2026-10-17): 61 downloads of v0.5.1 (GitHub releases), 1 star, 0 forks. Whether release builds produce telemetry events is still unverified (see next_gate). 0.6.0 adds Move to External Disk and `mac-dir-stat serve` (web page, REST, MCP with approve-only plans); from 0.6.0 the release workflow bumps the cask itself via the HOMEBREW_TAP_DEPLOY_KEY deploy key.

next_gate.statement: Resolve telemetry discrepancy (one self-run must produce an event), then star-push post (plan: docs/distribution/mac-dir-stat.md) toward 75 stars for homebrew cask.
